description: This PHP source file defines the SavePerformanceTrackerController class, which extends AbstractVueController. It handles rendering logic for the performance tracker save/edit views within the OrangeHRM Performance module, creating appropriate Vue components based on request attributes.

classes.name: SavePerformanceTrackerController
classes.description: Controller class managing the save/edit performance tracker Vue component rendering based on request attributes.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component to be rendered, selecting 'performance-tracker-edit' or 'performance-tracker-save' based on presence of 'id' in request attributes.
